This is the 1st episode of our Sri Lanka series. In this video we travel from Kandy to Nuwara Eliya. Kandy is about 114 km away from Colombo. It is a 2 day journey. Below are the activities we did in this journey.
We are buying spices from place of origins and making these available for you in smaller quantities.you can check out our website here.
Date of journey - 5th Sept 2026
Kandy - It is also known as Sri Lanka’s cultural capital and home to the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic.
Sahas Uyana - We had local Sri Lankan food in breakfast here at Hela Bojun Hala.
